text.en:
Barangays Sapa-Sapa, Baldatal Islam, Banaran Tong-gusong, Banaran Lookan, Lakit-Lakit,
Dalo-Dalo, Mantabuan Tabunan, Tapian Boheh, Labuan, Gadjaminah Palate, Likud Sicubong, Laum
Sicubong, Buton, Kohec and Malanta, all in the municipality of Tandubas, in the province of Tawi-Tawi, are
hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and independent municipality
which is hereby created to be known as the municipality of Sapa-Sapa without affecting in any manner the
legal existence of the Municipality of Tandubas.
The seat of government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Sapa-Sapa.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities shall be applicable to the new municipality of Sapa-Sapa.

The present elective officials of the Municipality of Tandubas shall perform their duties as such
in the newly created municipality until the officials of the latter shall have been duly appointed by the
President and they shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the election for provincial
and municipal officials following the issuance of this decree, and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed
at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to
complete the government personnel of the municipality of Sapa-Sapa shall be appointed as provided for under
existing laws.

Upon effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the new municipality of Sapa-Sapa in
the obligations, funds, assets and other property of the municipality of Tandubas shall be transferred by the
President to the newly created municipality upon recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 4th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
